title: Bam Adebayo, Tyler Herro involved in physical altercation in Las Vegas
author: Sam Amick
content:
Former Miami Heat teammates Bam Adebayo and Tyler Herro were involved in a physical altercation in Las Vegas on Friday, the Heat confirmed to The Athletic.

Adebayo and Herro played together for the Heat for seven seasons. Herro was part of the package Miami sent to the Milwaukee Bucks on July 6 in the deal that brought star Giannis Antetokounmpo to Miami.

Miami and Milwaukee played each other in Summer League action Friday at the Thomas & Mack Center in Las Vegas. Miami won the game 119-86. Herro attended the game and sat with his new teammates and coaches.

The Heat told The Athletic that they were aware of the incident and declined to comment. A Bucks person and several members of Taylor Jenkins’ coaching staff said they were unaware of the incident and also declined to comment.

Herro’s agent Jeff Schwartz did not immediately return a call seeking comment

This story will be updated.
